text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...'Biographies of Famous Umamusume 3',
'Super Training Methods Directly from Top Trainers'."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...We've finished watching all of them.
Is there anything else worth watching on this streaming service—
There is one!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ‘Crimson Warrior Tomatoborg’!"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: !? T-'Tomatoborg'...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember right... that's a tokusatsu show from quite a while ago, isn't it?
My older brother used to watch it way back when..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You thought this had nothing to do with racing, didn't you!
Well, you're dead wrong!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tomatoborg is nourishment for the soul!
The way he fights on with his fragile body mirrors the struggles of an umamusume taking on new challenges!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We can learn a fighting spirit
from this round body trying its best!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Come on, you get some lycopene power too!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...That was quite a passionate presentation.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I highly doubt this will deepen my understanding of racing...
...Shall we watch just one episode, then?

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Take this! Wave Equation!"
"Allow me to explain! The Wave Equation is—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
!! This theory...
I could apply it to my own racing theories!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, looks like 'Formula Squadron Theoranger' gave you a great hint!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I can integrate a new theory into my formula for victory!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to compare yourself to others.
You are strong! Move forward with courage.
You are... the hero!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Have courage...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Encouraging Fighter: Ganbaren"...
W-Where can I watch the movie version, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I was walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We're still holding our "Tomatoborg"
watch party today, right?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Next is the special training arc.
Please watch closely to see how we
build up this fragile body.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Overflow, lycopene power!"
Haha, I even memorized the line!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Me as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! "Formula Squadron Formulers"!?
Formula Squadron is a whole series?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...'It's all right~ You can do it,
toward tomorrow~ hip-hip hooray...'...♪"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That song! You always hum it before training together, right?
Is it a theme song for something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Umm... it's a song called "Ganbaren".
Well... it makes me feel like I can give it my best.
choice_data_list: Are hero shows trending right now...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yep!
I'm the one who spread it to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look at everyone's faces!
Don't they look positive and brighter than usual?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It's proof that everyone's everyday lives
have been illuminated by a hero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has times when they worry, or when they just need a push in the back.
At times like that—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Carry a hero inside your heart!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If heroes spread far and wide, the whole academy will shine brighter! Every day will be so much more powerful!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run to everyone's side
so that kind of future can become a reality.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Until the day a hero dwells in everyone's hearts!
choice_data_list: I want to see a hero that gives me strength too
I want to see a hero who gives people strength, too.
This will help the entire academy level up its skills!
Looks like this will help the whole academy level up their skills!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Until the day a hero dwells in everyone's hearts!
choice_data_list: I want to see a hero that gives me strength too
I want to see a hero who gives people strength, too.
This will help the entire academy level up its skills!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
something like "Sumo Warrior Dosukoida"
or "Muscle Man" would be great!
choice_data_list: It's hard to choose between the two.
It's hard to choose between the two.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What I recommend for a Trainer like that is...
the blockbuster hit "Assemble! Hero All-Stars"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: They give you as much energy as there are heroes! You're guaranteed to feel energized!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! To make that happen,
we gotta broaden our scope of activities!
choice_data_list: Can I give you a hand?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Yes, please!
Starting today, Trainer is officially part of our PR squad!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Spread the greatness of heroes
together with me!
